english.title: Fail to produce a personal flying log to an authorised person on request within 2 years of last entry
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person required under article 79 of the Air Navigation Order 2009 to keep a personal flying log, failed during the period of two years beginning with the date of the last entry in it, to cause it to be produced to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person, within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by that person
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 156(5), 241(5) of, and Part A of Schedule 13 to, the Air Navigation Order 2009.
